description: Create a clinical screening survey for an influenza vaccine study. The survey must calculate the participant's age from their Date of Birth and ONLY show the medical history section if they are between 18 and 65 years old (inclusive). Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!), create a new survey titled 'Influenza Vaccine Study Screener 2026'. In the first group, add a Date/Time question (Code: 'DOB') and a hidden Equation question (Code: 'AGE_CALC') that calculates age in years. Create a second group titled 'Medical History' that contains at least 3 medical questions. Set the 'Condition' or 'Relevance equation' for the 'Medical History' group so it is only visible if AGE_CALC is >= 18 and <= 65. Activate the survey when done.
